about_the_game:
March to the Heart takes classic board-based tactics and gives it a fresh twist: instead of just rolling dice to dominate a single map, you’ll play cards across a series of shifting territories—leading a desperate immune system faction deeper into a world under siege, on a journey to save the heart of the land.

It’s roguelike deckbuilding meets territorial tactics. Play cards to hold ground, upgrade zones, spawn cells, and unlock unique abilities. Every decision counts—defend critical ground or sacrifice it to outmaneuver the spreading infection. Once you’ve tipped the balance of power, push forward to purge the next zone and drive back the tide of death and decay once and for all.

An Infected World’s Last Hope

Command the survivors of a once technologically advanced immune system in a last march toward the heart of the land. Use your cards to fortify key regions or launch tactical strikes against an infection that spreads with every turn.

  • Tactical Territory Control

Build factories in your territories to defeat your foes, or be an ever shifting scavengers wearing down your opponent. A rich set of tactics are possible, all grounded in turn-based, territorial, combat.

 

  • Recruit, Collect, Remember

Discover hidden outposts and gather survivors to strengthen your forces. Find strange relics and forgotten artifacts that grant powerful new abilities—and stir memories of what’s at stake.

 

  • Adapt and Overcome

Choose from four distinct factions, each with unique decks and playstyles. Face evolving enemies with unpredictable tactics. No two runs are the same—each journey brings new challenges and discoveries as you march toward the heart to safe the world from a total collapse.

For Roguelike Minds and Tactical Hearts

If you’re a fan of roguelike deckbuilders, turn-based tactics, or just love an immersive sci-fi world full of hidden secrets, then March to the Heart is the game for you.

  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2017 Ryzen 2200g, i3 8100
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: March to the Heart is a tactical deckbuilding game set within a dying body. Command the immune system’s last hope to fight a disease. Expand your deck and make sacrifices to make your way through an increasingly infected world were each attempt provides a unique set of choices leading to the heart.
